classification.difficultyReason: Complete cumulative tables and graphs, construct ogives and distinguish a graphical estimate from the exact middle observations.

content.prompt: Find the median from these cumulative frequency graphs.

spec.description: Four adjoining cumulative-frequency bars and the supplied black ogive. Ordinary bar fill is omitted under the approved shading policy.
spec.answerVisibility: Bars, axes, ticks, grid and supplied ogive are permanent givens. No median construction or answer is supplied.

answer.worked:
The total is $6$, so half the cumulative frequency is $3$. Reading across to the supplied ogive and down gives $6$.

For the exact median, the third and fourth observations both have score $6$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{6+6}{2}\\\text{Median}&=6\end{align*}$$

answer.worked:
Join the upper-right bar corners to form the ogive, beginning at the lower-left bar corner. The total is $14$, so read across from cumulative frequency $7$ and then down. The graphical estimate is about $42.9$.

For the exact ungrouped median, positions $7$ and $8$ both have score $43$: the cumulative count is $5$ at $42$ and $10$ at $43$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{43+43}{2}\\\text{Median}&=43\end{align*}$$

answer.worked:
Cumulative frequencies: $2,3,6,9,10,14$.

$$\begin{align*}\Sigma f&=2+1+3+3+1+4\\\Sigma f&=14\end{align*}$$

The total agrees with the final cumulative frequency. Draw the cumulative bars and join their upper-right corners. At half the total, $7$, the ogive gives an estimate between $3$ and $4$.

The seventh and eighth observations both have score $4$: cumulative frequency rises from $6$ at score $3$ to $9$ at score $4$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{4+4}{2}\\\text{Median}&=4\end{align*}$$

answer.short: Cumulative frequencies: $15,25,32,43,64$. $\Sigma f=64$. Median: $17.5$, the mean of $15$ and $20$.
answer.worked:
Cumulative frequencies: $15,25,32,43,64$.

$$\begin{align*}\Sigma f&=15+10+7+11+21\\\Sigma f&=64\end{align*}$$

Draw the cumulative bars centred on the given scores and join their upper-right corners. Half the total is $32$; the ogive construction gives $17.5$.

For the exact median, positions $32$ and $33$ have scores $15$ and $20$ respectively. The cumulative count is $32$ at score $15$ and $43$ at score $20$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{15+20}{2}\\\text{Median}&=17.5\end{align*}$$
